Thank you for reporting!

For issues:
 * Try the latest version, it may have fixed the issue already.
 * If you crashed, please paste the crash log to [gist](https://gist.github.com/) and link it here, or at least paste it directly to the issue and wrap it in "```".
 * If possible, please provide your logs.
 * Please provide your Minecraft version, NeoForge version and mod version.
 * Any additional information how to reproduce your problem and screenshots will be helpful.
